base.description: The branch PRs land in, unless a repo overrides it.

pass_env.description: Host environment variables copied into every service.

StackSpec.description: The whole of `spinner.yaml`. `pipeline` is typed by the board's `pipeline.ts`.

path.description: Path of the repo on this machine. May start with `~`, or be relative to the spec file.

base.description: Branch the worktree starts from and the PR targets. Overrides the top-level `base`.

seed_files.description: Untracked files (`.npmrc`, `.env.local`) that `spinner new` copies from the primary checkout into the worktree when they are absent there. Paths relative to the repo.

seed_links.description: Local directories (`.venv`, `node_modules`) that the worktree symlinks to the primary checkout's copy instead of installing again, as a team's worktree tool does. Paths relative to the repo. The link is excluded from git through `info/exclude`.

repo.description: Name under `repos`. When set, the session's worktree is bind-mounted at `/app`.

image.description: Image name. Built from `dockerfile` when set, else from the repo's `Dockerfile.dev` (next to `workdir`, then at the repo root) when one exists, else pulled. Required unless `runtime` is `host`.

dockerfile.description: A dev Dockerfile outside the repo, relative to the spec file; its directory is the build context. For private multi-repo setups whose repos must stay untouched.

wrapper.description: Command prefix run before `command`, for a secrets injector. Relative to the worktree.

workdir.description: Directory inside the worktree where `command` runs.

preflight.description: For `runtime: host`: a command run in `workdir`, through `wrapper` and with the same environment, before the service starts. A non-zero exit fails `up` at once with the command's last lines, for an import error a dev server would only log.

port.description: The port the process listens on inside the container. A host service gets one assigned.

host.description: Hostname label: `<host>.<session>.localhost`. Services without one are internal only.

env.description: Environment for the process. Values may use `${SESSION_ID}` and the other variables.

env_file.description: Path inside the worktree where the runner writes `env` before start, for frontends that read their environment at build time from a dotenv file.

healthcheck.description: `GET /path`: polled through the service port until it answers 2xx.

install.description: The install command for the dependency volume, run once in the lockfile's directory, instead of the one the lockfile implies (`npm ci`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`). For a repo that needs `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`.

upstreams.description: Path prefix on this service's hostname to an outside URL, proxied by Traefik with the prefix stripped: `/upstream/legacy: https://api.acme.example` makes `http://<host>.<id>.localhost/upstream/legacy/x` fetch `https://api.acme.example/x` from the page's own origin, for an API whose CORS allows only fixed origins.

publish.description: Container ports a `runtime: host` service must reach, published on loopback at a per-session port. `env` may refer to it as `${<SERVICE>_<PORT>_HOST_PORT}`, for example `${TEMPORAL_7233_HOST_PORT}`.

preview.description: How the UI embeds the preview. Defaults to `frame`.

ServiceRuntime.description: Where the service runs. `node` and `python` run in a container and pick the healthcheck probe and the kind of dependency volume. `host` runs the command on the host, in the worktree, for a service whose dependencies have no wheel for the container platform; Spinner assigns it a port and routes its hostname to it.

DepsVolume.description: The kind of dependency volume a service mounts. The volume name is keyed by the hash of the repo's lockfile, so sessions with the same lockfile share one install.

PreviewMode.description: How the UI embeds the service's preview. `frame` (the default) is an iframe. `top-level` marks an app that needs its own top-level page, for example one whose login cookie is `SameSite=Lax`: the desktop app shows it in a `WebContentsView`, and the browser UI keeps the iframe but tells the operator to open it in a tab.

version.description: Postgres major version for the `spinner-postgres` container.

template.description: Name of the template database. Defaults to `<name>_seed`.

DatabaseServer.description: `spinner-postgres` is a container Spinner starts; `external` is a server it never manages.

password.description: Password, when the server needs one. Defaults to the user name, as local stacks do.

admin_user.description: A superuser for the steps `user` may not do, such as clearing the template flag of an invalid database on Supabase. Defaults to `supabase_admin`, same password.

dump.description: A SQL file or a gzip-compressed SQL file, relative to the spec file.

migrate.description: Host command that applies migrations. Runs in the primary checkout of `repo` with `DATABASE_URL` set to a fresh, empty template database, unless `source` is set.

fixtures.description: Host command that loads fixtures, after `migrate`, in the same environment.

repo.description: Repo whose primary checkout the commands run in. Defaults to the first repo.

source.description: Name of the database the commands fill when they ignore `DATABASE_URL`, for example `postgres` for a Supabase stack. It is copied into the template afterwards.

after.description: SQL statements run on the template after it is built, for grants a snapshot lacks.

strip_frame_headers.description: Services whose responses lose `X-Frame-Options` and `frame-ancestors`, to embed them.
